title: ORLY Loop
subtitle: From a GitHub issue to a published video

chapters.title: The Issue Is the Interface
chapters.blurb: A five-field form is the whole request — and one label is the approval.

chapters.title: Captions Are the Script
chapters.blurb: Plan the pictures first; every chapter is a scene whose captions are the spoken lines.

chapters.title: Written for the Ear
chapters.blurb: A gauntlet bounces anything a narrator would mangle; character timestamps become exact cues.

chapters.title: Evidence, Not Confidence
chapters.blurb: A headless browser runs every chapter and demands evidence it animates.

chapters.title: The Loop Closes
chapters.blurb: A pull request, a live preview, a reply to revise — merge, and the shelf grows by one.
